h1: Cubic Bangna — a 9-minute walk to BITEC, spotlessly clean, with staff that guests can't stop praising
intro: If you are heading to an exhibition or trade show at BITEC Bang Na and want a three-star base you can literally walk to from the venue, Cubic Bangna is one of the names that keeps coming up. The hotel sits on Debaratna Road in the Bang Na district, just 700 metres — about 9 minutes on foot — from the BITEC gates. BTS Bang Na station is about the same distance away, and from there a covered skywalk connects directly into BITEC. The hotel has 39 rooms, a business centre, a meeting room, a garden lounge and a 24-hour front desk. It holds a score of 9.2 from 258 reviews on Trip.com, with 254 of those positive, and staff and cleanliness both rated at 9.5. Rooms start from approx. THB 1,300/night in normal periods, rising sharply around major BITEC events.

body.html: Cubic Bangna is on Debaratna Road, 700 metres from BITEC — walk out the front door and you are at the exhibition centre in about nine minutes. If it rains or you are carrying booth materials, BTS Bang Na station is roughly the same distance in the other direction, and a covered skywalk runs from Bang Na station straight into BITEC without a step outside. For anyone exhibiting, attending or working at a BITEC event, this is as good as the location gets at the 3-star price point.

The hotel has 39 rooms across four types: Studio (one King bed), Standard Twin (two single beds), Standard Quadruple (two Queen beds) and Superior Twin (two Queen beds). Every room has air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a work desk, a mini-fridge, free Wi-Fi and an ensuite bathroom with a wet/dry separation — the bathroom layout is one of the details guest reviews specifically call out. Several mention crisp, white bedding and a standard of cleanliness that feels closer to a five-star than a three-star, which is reflected in the 9.5 cleanliness score.
"Extremely close to BITEC — easily within walking distance. Spotless rooms, and the staff were incredibly kind. They even came outside to help direct our driver. Would come back 100 percent."

Staff service is the other consistent theme. Out of 258 reviews, the service score is 9.5 — genuinely exceptional for a property at this price. Reviewers describe front-desk staff who do not wait to be asked: coordinating with taxi drivers, coming outside to navigate arriving vehicles, and sorting out small issues without being prompted. One block of reviews from regular BITEC visitors specifically notes that "there has not been a negative review in over a year" — a rare consistency for any hotel.

The shared facilities include a business centre, meeting room, garden, communal lounge, luggage storage and a 24-hour front desk. A 7-Eleven and an Amazon Cafe are very close by — handy for picking up coffee and breakfast before heading over to the exhibition hall. What the hotel does not have is an in-house restaurant or a breakfast buffet, so if that matters to you, budget to eat out — though the convenience options nearby make it workable for most trade-show schedules.

Two things worth knowing before you book. First, road noise: the hotel sits beside a main road, and a handful of reviews mention hearing traffic and even some vibration from larger vehicles passing at night. If you are a light sleeper, ask for a room facing the garden side when you check in. Second, a damage deposit of THB 1,000 is collected at check-in and a few reviews mention it taking longer than expected to be refunded after check-out — check the timeline with staff before you leave.

Rates run from roughly THB 1,300 to around THB 1,900/night depending on room type and time of year. During major BITEC events — Motor Expo, the International Boat Show, large-scale trade fairs — rooms fill weeks in advance and prices can double or more. If you know the event date, booking four to eight weeks out is not too early; choosing a free-cancellation rate first is a sensible hedge.

honestSummary: Cubic Bangna is the clearest three-star choice for anyone attending an event at BITEC: the nine-minute walk to the venue is the whole point, the staff are genuinely outstanding, and the rooms are kept cleaner than the star rating suggests. The trade-offs — no restaurant, some road noise, a damage deposit that takes time to return — are real but minor for a stay built around a trade show.

tips.title: Walk or take the BTS to BITEC
tips.body: From the hotel it is a 9-min walk to BITEC. In heavy rain or if you are hauling gear, take BTS Bang Na (one stop from Udom Suk) and use the covered skywalk directly into the venue — no getting wet.

tips.title: Ask for a garden-facing room
tips.body: Rooms on the garden side are noticeably quieter than those overlooking the main road. Mention it when you book or at check-in — most staff will do their best to accommodate.

tips.title: Book early around major BITEC events
tips.body: Motor Expo, the International Boat Show and other large BITEC events fill the hotel weeks in advance and push prices sharply higher. Book four to eight weeks out and lock in a free-cancellation rate.

tips.title: Grab breakfast at the nearby Amazon Cafe
tips.body: There is an Amazon Cafe and a 7-Eleven within easy walking distance — quick, easy and cheap for coffee and something to eat before heading over to the exhibition hall.

faq.q: How far is Cubic Bangna from BITEC Bang Na?
faq.a: Cubic Bangna is at 8 Debaratna Road in the Bang Na district, approximately 700 metres from BITEC — around a 9-minute walk. In bad weather or when carrying equipment, you can take BTS Bang Na and use the covered skywalk that connects the station directly to the BITEC entrance without going outside.

faq.q: How much does Cubic Bangna cost, and what room types are available?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. THB 1,300/night for a Studio room with a King bed. Other options include Standard Twin (two single beds, good for colleagues sharing), Standard Quadruple (two Queen beds, up to four guests) and Superior Twin. During major BITEC events, prices rise significantly and rooms sell out fast — book well in advance.

faq.q: Is there a breakfast buffet at Cubic Bangna?
faq.a: No — Cubic Bangna does not have an in-house restaurant or a hotel breakfast buffet. However, a 7-Eleven and an Amazon Cafe are within a short walk, making it easy to grab coffee and something to eat before heading over to BITEC.

faq.q: Is Cubic Bangna near a BTS station?
faq.a: BTS Bang Na (Sukhumvit line, station E13) is about 670 metres away — an 8 to 9-minute walk. From Bang Na station, a covered skywalk runs directly into BITEC, which is convenient for attendees travelling in from other parts of Bangkok.

faq.q: Who is Cubic Bangna best suited for?
faq.a: It is the ideal pick for business travellers, exhibitors, buyers and conference delegates attending events at BITEC Bang Na — the walking distance to the venue is the main reason to book here. It is less suited to leisure stays, as there is no pool or gym, and no in-house restaurant.
